definitions.explanation: Snow that falls heavily or in large amounts.

examples.japanese: {大雪|おおゆき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: School was closed due to heavy snow.

examples.japanese: {大雪|おおゆき}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A heavy snow advisory was issued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大雪|おおゆき}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{大雪|おおゆき} means heavy or substantial snowfall. It combines ⟦{大|おお}→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ (big, heavy) + ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ (snow).

PRONUNCIATION:
As a common word: {大雪|おおゆき}. As a solar term (one of the 24 seasonal divisions): {大雪|たいせつ} (around December 7).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大雪|おおゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: heavy snow falls
- {大雪|おおゆき}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧: heavy snow warning
- {大雪|おおゆき}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧: heavy snow advisory
- {大雪|おおゆき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧: delayed due to heavy snow
- {大雪|おおゆき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧: to be hit by heavy snow

RELATED WEATHER WORDS:
- ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧: heavy rain
- ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧: blizzard
- ⟦{粉雪|こなゆき}→粉雪：13858_konayuki⟧: powder snow
- ⟦{初雪|はつゆき}→初雪：11784_hatsuyuki⟧: first snow of the season
- ⟦{積雪|せきせつ}→積雪：14737_sekisetsu⟧: accumulated snow

CULTURAL NOTE:
Heavy snow is a significant concern in Japan's Sea of Japan side (⟦{日本海|にほんかい}→日本海：noentry⟧⟦{側|がわ}→側：03090_gawa⟧), where some areas receive several meters of snow annually. {大雪|おおゆき} frequently disrupts ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧ services and ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧ travel.
